symptom: `mxcli test tests/ -p app/App.mpr` fails with "no such file or directory" for a `tests/` that sits right next to the `.mpr`
cause: Test paths resolved against the process CWD only. Defensible in isolation, but mxcli otherwise encourages naming the project (`-p`) rather than standing in its directory, and project auto-discovery searches outward — so the two conventions collide and the failure looks like a missing directory
insight: Fall back to project-relative **only when the CWD-relative path does not exist**: a `tests/` in both places must resolve to the one the user is standing in, since silently preferring the project's copy would run the wrong suite. A path that exists in neither is passed through unchanged so the error names what was typed, not a rewritten path the user never mentioned. Tests `cmd/mxcli/cmd_test_run_paths_test.go`. mxcli-formula1 #13
